newsitem.title: USA: Reinoso & Co. to exit municipal bond business.
newsitem.headline: Reinoso & Co. to exit municipal bond business.

text.p: Reinoso & Co. said Friday it will exit the municipal bond business and layoff its municipal staff.
In a statement announcing the move, the company said it "will instead pursue potential opportunities in other areas of the financial industry."

"I believe, contrary to public opinion, that there is a future in this business, but that may take some time, and for the here-and-now we want to focus on other opportunities," Edward Reinoso, the New York-based company's president, said.
"We have a highly qualified and professional staff that I'm sure will have no problem finding positions elsewhere, and we wish all of our friends and associates continued success," Reinoso said.

The statement, which a company official said was the only information being released, did not say how many people were affected by the move. Reinoso lists a total of 20 people in its New York office in The Bond Buyer's directory of muni firms.
However, one of Reinoso's key executives, Matthew Deane, left last month to join Merrill Lynch & Co's public finance department.
The 11-year old firm said it would not comment on near-term plans, but said operations are "on-going and various strategies are being studied."
